summary: A fresh Grok 4.6/xhigh run on marketplace skill-craft 2.36.2 / ShipLoop 1.33.7 copied a passed ticket-assignment product, with no predecessor run state, and accepted 12 actions through W1/S1 test.

The run is STOPPED: the host hit 7,201.3 seconds at W1/S1 document. Planning used 107.6 engine minutes, including 57.5 minutes in four inline Improve children; 11 compactions were recorded. No final delivery or held-out quality result exists.

Cold recovery and partial preservation worked: Discovery created a current-system baseline, planning retained R-1–R-5 and added R-6–R-9, and the unreturned worktree passed 125 configured tests, 117/117 pristine tests and the existing assignment HTTP check.

The requested HTTP reassignment and escalation remain unfinished. Reviews made substantive replay/oracle/default-value corrections, so their cost does not establish waste. No same-cell control supports changing stages, review or driver defaults.

Two evidence defects remain open: narrowed S1 test receipts retain later-step criteria, and the source-side pristine helper discards its subprocess-timeout explanation. Both have small hermetic regression routes; no retry is authorized.

basis.P1: Holds for the accepted prefix: 12 actions advanced through ShipLoop records; the host timeout, not a model-selected transition, ended the attempt.
basis.P2: Holds with a scope limit: four inline Improve children have receipts and ten passes; they are not independent external reviewers.
basis.P3: Holds for the observed prefix: two ShipLoop check refusals were corrected without operator-supplied callbacks or coaching.
basis.P4: Holds through the last accepted test action; document was never accepted and no later stage was claimed.
basis.P5: Broken by the narrowed-receipt criterion overstatement; the pristine helper also loses its timeout explanation. Partial worktree evidence is separately preserved.
basis.P6: Examined, not rated: there is no same-cell control and no completed Grok delivery, so model independence cannot be inferred.
basis.B2: Not applicable to a product conclusion: Plan explicitly used dependency audit only and no Backchain loop was launched.

cold-additive-timeout-20261111.title: Cold additive run exhausted its two-hour cap before W1 documentation
cold-additive-timeout-20261111.expected: The registered run reaches a terminal ShipLoop outcome within its explicit 7,200-second host allowance.
cold-additive-timeout-20261111.observed: STOPPED at 7,201.3 seconds with document active; 107.6 planning minutes, 57.5 Improve minutes and 11 compactions. Partial worktree preservation passed; no delivery was returned.
cold-additive-timeout-20261111.advice: Retain this as a stopped measurement pilot, not proof that planning review or the Grok driver should change. Inferred: avoidable cost exists, but this run cannot separate review yield from host and compaction cost.

narrowed-criteria-overstated-20261111.title: A narrowed S1 test receipt retained later-step criteria
narrowed-criteria-overstated-20261111.expected: When active_commands narrows a focused command to TC_7–TC_9 for S1, its receipt names only the criteria those cases exercise: C1–C3.
narrowed-criteria-overstated-20261111.observed: The accepted verify record names TC_7–TC_9 with C1–C6. C4–C6 belong to S2; the three store-level tests ran and passed, but their HTTP stimuli were deliberately replaced by service.store.reassign.
narrowed-criteria-overstated-20261111.advice: Filter criteria with the same due-step projection used for IDs, preserving store-level credit while leaving HTTP obligations open. This is receipt accuracy, not a product failure or lifecycle change.

pristine-timeout-diagnostic-20261111.title: The pristine-test failure discarded its subprocess-timeout reason
pristine-timeout-diagnostic-20261111.expected: A source-side pristine-test timeout reports that node --test exceeded its allowance.
pristine-timeout-diagnostic-20261111.observed: The result says 0 of 117 pass, 0 fail, rc None and no failing test named. node_test had the timeout explanation, but pristine replaced it with the generic failing-names text. The partial worktree pristine check separately passed 117/117.
pristine-timeout-diagnostic-20261111.advice: Retain the node_test output in the pristine failure so the operator can diagnose the source-side hang. Do not interpret 0/117 here as 117 behavioral failures.

accept-cold-additive-stopped-20261111.title: Retain the stopped pilot without changing lifecycle defaults
accept-cold-additive-stopped-20261111.goal: Do: record the cold additive attempt as STOPPED, preserving its partial preservation evidence and the absence of a same-cell control; change no stage, review, driver or loop default. Files and symbols: test/shiploop_e2e/LEARNINGS.md and this run review. Test: none; this records a known limit. Done when: the learning entry names the timeout, partial worktree results, contrary review value and raw evidence location.
accept-cold-additive-stopped-20261111.why: The run does not isolate an avoidable mechanism or qualify a replacement. The partial handoff and reviews worked, while completion remains unknown.

compare-cold-additive-cell-20261111.title: Separately register a completed cold-additive comparison
compare-cold-additive-cell-20261111.cost: Another live model run; not authorized by this investigation.
compare-cold-additive-cell-20261111.goal: Do: if the owner later prioritizes this question, register a fresh comparison with a fixed predecessor, literal request, host/model/effort and explicit budget; measure fail-to-pass, pass-to-pass, unnecessary rework and material review corrections. Files and symbols: test/shiploop_e2e/run.py follow-on controls and a new external registration. Test: run the registered baseline and candidate checks with old run state absent. Done when: the retained result supports a bounded decision or remains explicitly failed, stopped or inconclusive with its evidence.
compare-cold-additive-cell-20261111.why: Only a separately controlled completed comparison can distinguish stage value from host and compaction cost. No retry or budget change is presumed.

fix-narrowed-criteria-20261111.title: Filter narrowed command criteria to the cases that remain
fix-narrowed-criteria-20261111.goal: Do: when active_commands narrows a focused command IDs list, derive its criteria from the retained cases due at that step instead of carrying later-step criteria. Files and symbols: active_commands in skills/shiploop/scripts/shiploop_iteration.py and its contract in test/shiploop-iteration.test.py. Test: add a fail-first two-step fixture matching TC_7–TC_9 and C1–C6, then replay the retained verify record. Done when: S1 reports TC_7–TC_9 with C1–C3, S2 retains its own obligations, minimum/full regression behavior is unchanged, and the focused suites pass.
fix-narrowed-criteria-20261111.why: For: removes a demonstrated overstatement with a small local change. Against: criteria can span steps, so the projection must use the existing due rule rather than list position. Verdict: worth a focused repair; no live run is needed to establish the mapping.

fix-pristine-timeout-diagnostic-20261111.title: Preserve the pristine subprocess timeout explanation
fix-pristine-timeout-diagnostic-20261111.goal: Do: include the output returned by node_test when pristine rejects a run, including its explicit timeout text when return code is None. Files and symbols: pristine and failing_names in test/shiploop_e2e/checks/base_tests.py and its harness tests. Test: simulate subprocess.TimeoutExpired and verify the failure names the elapsed allowance instead of only no failing test named. Done when: that regression passes and an ordinary pristine pass remains unchanged.
fix-pristine-timeout-diagnostic-20261111.why: For: preserves the actual diagnostic needed to investigate a hang. Against: this changes reporting only and does not diagnose or fix the hang. Verdict: retain as a small harness repair.

accept-pristine-cause-unknown-20261111.title: Keep the source-side pristine hang unresolved
accept-pristine-cause-unknown-20261111.goal: Do: record that the source-side pristine subprocess timed out with its cause unknown and that the partial worktree pristine check passed; do not claim a product regression. Files and symbols: test/shiploop_e2e/LEARNINGS.md and the retained result.json. Test: none; this records a known limit. Done when: the learning distinguishes the timeout from assertion failures and names both source-side and worktree observations.
accept-pristine-cause-unknown-20261111.why: The run ended at its host deadline and the diagnostic was incomplete; no cause is established.
